findings.issue: The desktop hero photo still has lettering printed into it ('…Sunlit Days', 'and summer-ready prints', and 'Shop Swimwear' / 'Explore the Collection' pills), which shows behind our live H1, lead and button, and the trust bar cuts off the last pill. The hero reads as two overlapping layers of text with dead buttons under the live one (reported before; unchanged in these shots).
findings.reference: The competitor's hero photo is a clean shot with no lettering. The only text on it is the live eyebrow, title, lead and two buttons.
findings.fix: Give /custom-swimwear-printing/ a hero photo with no lettering in it, and take the lettered photo out of the photo pool until it is regenerated without the text.

findings.issue: On phones the wide-variant factory photo keeps its desktop strip ratio (about 2.3:1, imageShare 0.17), so it shrinks to a band about 150 px tall under a long run of text (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: The competitor's phone photos in text sections (the handover/mock-up image) run full width at a near-square or 4:3 ratio.
findings.fix: In reference.css at the stacked breakpoint, give the .block--split[data-variant="wide"] media aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 with object-fit: cover.

findings.issue: In the 2×2 phone trust bar, 'up to 3 business days' wraps to two lines while '300 dpi' stays on one, so the two labels in the first row ('SUBLIMATION QUOTE TIME' and 'MINIMUM ARTWORK RESOLUTION') sit at different heights.
findings.reference: The competitor has no trust bar. In its rows of cards and steps, the parts of each item in one row line up.
findings.fix: In reference.css at the phone breakpoint, lay the trust bar items out on a shared two-row grid (grid-template-rows: subgrid, or the value aligned to the end of its row) so that each row's values and labels line up.

findings.issue: Two neighbouring sections of the same shape still stand one under the other: m7 (process) and m8 (iconList) both set their rows of short items as a list beside the heading, which leaves two long empty left-hand columns in a row (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: Site rule: of two neighbouring short-item sections, only one is set as a list beside its heading. The competitor sets its steps as a band of columns under the heading ('Six steps from Costing to delivery').
findings.fix: When a process list and an iconList are neighbours, have the template set one of them differently: m8 as items in columns under its heading, or m7 in the process 'band' arrangement.

findings.issue: After the photo band, m12 (proof), owner-testimonials and related all sit on white, so three neighbouring plain sections do not alternate (at both widths; reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: The competitor alternates beige with white or navy from section to section. Site rule: the template alternates white and --section-tint between neighbouring plain sections.
findings.fix: Include testimonials and relatedPages blocks in the template's white/tint alternation so the run reads white, tint, white.

findings.issue: On phones the comparison table still cuts its fourth column off at the right edge ('Pigm… with und…', 'Digit… pigm… print…'), and the label column is so narrow that 'White or pastel areas' stacks one word per line (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: On phones the competitor shows comparisons as stacked panels (the 'Plain colours' / 'Prints' cards), with nothing cut off at the side.
findings.fix: Give the comparison chart (.chart-comparison) a stacked phone layout: one card per option column, its rows as label/value pairs, instead of the sideways scroll.

findings.issue: The process step titles ('Scale and trial print', 'A4 approval options', and the same in splitMedia-1-steps) are still set at body size and differ from the text only in weight. They read as smaller than the iconList item titles in the sections around them (m5, m8), so one level of heading has two sizes on the page (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: The competitor's step titles ('Custom Designs', 'Fabrics & Colours') are clearly larger than the step text under them, at the same level as its other card titles.
findings.fix: Have the template size process step titles (.process list item heading) at the same subheading level as iconList and featureGrid item titles; no site rule sets the size.

findings.issue: The related link cards still name services (Embroidery, Consulting, Packaging & Labels, Hardware) with only text and an arrow, with no line icon (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: The competitor's matching link cards (Book a Call-Back, WhatsApp, Email Us, Visit Us) each have a line icon at the left and an arrow at the right. Site rule: cards that name services carry a line icon.
findings.fix: Give the relatedPages 'links' cards a line icon slot before the label, filled per linked service.

findings.issue: On phones the wide closing photo is still cropped to the copy's height, so the heading, lead and button cover almost the whole frame. The woman's face is cut away, and the photo reads as a dark texture (reported before; unchanged).
findings.reference: On phones the competitor keeps each photo's subject in frame (its phone hero switches to a portrait shot), and its closing module has no wide photo squeezed behind text.
findings.fix: Give the image-band CTA a portrait or square twin photo on phones (as phoneHeroes does for the hero) instead of cropping the wide one to the copy.
